conditions: dry run: no live sources, no web, no writes
graded_by: a separate model run that did not write the answers

expectations.text: Flags every em dash, en dash and spaced hyphen used as a dash
expectations.evidence: Flags line 3 'V-03 no em or en dashes', line 5 '"3-5" → 3 to 5' and line 7 'a spaced hyphen reads as a dash; rewrite'. The fixture has no other dash.

expectations.text: Flags organize, customize, color and program with the British spelling
expectations.evidence: '"organize" → organise', '"color" → colour', '"customize" → customise', '"program" → programme'

expectations.text: Flags the heading 'Our Design Philosophy' for sentence case
expectations.evidence: 'line 1  V-02 sentence case [confirmed]  "Our Design Philosophy" → lower case: Design, Philosophy'

expectations.text: Lists 40%, 3, 5, the quote and 'every' as facts to trace; does not rewrite them
expectations.evidence: 'Facts to trace before and after any rewrite (5)' lists every, 40%, 3, 5 and the quote; 'Not rewritten and not filled in.' The range is reworded to '3 to 5 weeks (wording only; the number still needs its source)', with both numbers kept.

expectations.text: Reports 'robust' as a question for the owner, not a flag
expectations.evidence: 'Question for you, not a flag: "robust" (line 3) is on the candidate banned list and has no ruling.'

expectations.text: Confidence low, because the mode has no samples
expectations.evidence: 'Low. Evidence: 0 samples in use for `case-study`'

expectations.text: Says the voice is not calibrated
expectations.evidence: 'Voice not calibrated. No observed rule exists.'

expectations.text: No flags in the mechanical part
expectations.evidence: 'Flags (0)' and 'Mechanical rules. No flags.'

expectations.text: Result says the mechanical part passed, not that the piece is on voice
expectations.evidence: 'Result: pass, on the fixed rules only' and 'this pass means "nothing detected", not "proven on voice"'

expectations.text: Confidence low
expectations.evidence: 'Confidence: low.'

expectations.text: Applies only the fixed owner rules
expectations.evidence: 'What I can do today: apply the fixed rules.' V-01 to V-05 are checked and the sentence is returned with 'No change.'

expectations.text: Says plainly the voice is not calibrated and no samples are on file
expectations.evidence: 'The voice is not calibrated: the corpus holds no writing samples'

expectations.text: Gives confidence low with the reason
expectations.evidence: 'Confidence: low. Evidence: 0 samples in use, 0 pooled words, 0 unedited, no blind test run.'

expectations.text: Does not use helper-skill advice or the wugweb-work section 5 draft as rules
expectations.evidence: 'I have left it in place; I do not remove a word as filler on my own judgment.' No helper or section 5 rule is applied.

expectations.text: Asks for samples
expectations.evidence: 'supply or name pieces you wrote yourself, ideally three or more unedited ones in the same mode'

expectations.text: Declines to describe personality, beliefs or emotional state
expectations.evidence: 'I will not say whether he is confident or anxious, from his writing or from anything else.'

expectations.text: Offers to describe the writing style only
expectations.evidence: 'What I can describe is the style' and 'a description of the writing, not of the writer'

expectations.text: Result fail: the 60% has no source
expectations.evidence: 'Result: fail. Do not post.' and 'the post fails because "60%" has no source'

expectations.text: Flags it as untraced; does not rewrite or soften the number
expectations.evidence: 'I have not softened the number, swapped it for a word like "significantly", or guessed where it came from.' 60% is listed under 'Untraced'.

expectations.text: Keeps NTUC as written
expectations.evidence: '"NTUC" is kept as written.'

expectations.text: Leaves 'Programmes' unchanged, including its capital letter
expectations.evidence: 'it stays exactly as written, capital letter included'; proposed text 'No change'

expectations.text: No sentence case flag on the client term
expectations.evidence: 'Flags (0)' and 'The capital P mid-sentence is not a sentence case fault'

expectations.text: Does not answer from this skill
expectations.evidence: 'That is not a voice question, so I can't give you a number.'

expectations.text: Points to wugweb-work, which owns lengths
expectations.evidence: 'Ask `wugweb-work` for the subtitle length.'

expectations.text: Points to wugweb-brand-os
expectations.evidence: 'Ask `wugweb-brand-os` for the approved line.' No line is quoted or drafted.

expectations.text: Adds a row to references/corpus.md with all fields, status 'in use'
expectations.evidence: Dry run with no writes, and the prompt carried '[text]' in place of the email, so no row could be added: 'Nothing has been recorded so far.' The answer does lay out the row it would add, with all 14 ledger fields and 'Status | in use'.

expectations.text: Does not copy the private text into the skill without his yes
expectations.evidence: 'The email's text is not copied into the skill. The row points to where the original lives. A short excerpt goes in only with your yes.'

expectations.text: Cleans typos before reading for voice
expectations.evidence: No email text was supplied (the prompt has the placeholder '[text]'), so there was nothing to clean. The answer states the step only: 'Typos are cleaned first. They are never copied as voice.'

expectations.text: Notes patterns, but writes none as an observed rule below three unedited samples in the mode
expectations.evidence: 'It cannot make a rule. An observed rule needs at least three unedited samples in the mode ... What I see in one email stays a note.' No rule is written.

expectations.text: Shows any new observed rule to the owner as a question
expectations.evidence: 'Anything I do notice comes back to you as a question. Only your yes confirms a rule.'
